items.text: Ticket: the date picker on the booking page cannot be used with the keyboard alone.
Ticket: hovering over a booking in week view shows its time but not who booked it.
Ticket from the old queue, filed before last week's date fix: users in Germany typed 03/04 for a booking date and got 4 March instead of 3 April.
Ticket from the old queue: invite links never expire. A former employee used an old invite to join a team calendar a month later.
Ticket: EU accounts want the dates in the CSV export as dd/mm, not mm/dd. Should be a one-line change.
Ticket: the calendar feed sends all-day bookings as midnight to midnight. Send them as real all-day events.
Ticket: customer asks for a 15 min booking granularity. Currently the smallest slot is 30 min.
Ticket: a screen reader user says every icon button on the booking page is read out as just 'button'. Give them proper labels.
Ticket: the 'today' button is missing from week view on phones.
Ticket: a studio in Berlin says the calendar starts the week on Sunday. Their staff expect Monday.
